name: nadocast-day1-tornado-benchmark-v1
product: Day 1 tornado: probability of a tornado report within 25 miles (40.2336 km) of a point during the convective day 12Z-12Z

ours.model: v0.7 (live production, frozen coefficients research/severe/baseline-v07/models.json, product day1_tornado)
ours.footprint: v0.7 regional box (-100..-75 E, 30..45 N), stride-5 HRRR sample centres

nadocast.issue: 12Z run on D-1 (HREF/SREF), valid f24-47 = convective day D; published the afternoon of D-1
nadocast.reason_not_day1: The archive has no 0Z cycle. NadoCast's own Day 1 (12Z f02-23 on D) starts after 12Z D and is issued after our cutoff, so it is reported separately as a later-cutoff reference, never in the head-to-head.
reported_not_deciding: 2024_preliminary models absolutely calibrated, D-1 12Z f24-47, where available
later-cutoff reference: 2022 models absolutely calibrated, 12Z f02-23 on D (valid from ~13:30Z D)
nadocast.grid: Lambert 387x226, 15.237 km (HREF cropped, 3x downsampled); TORPROB in percent; no missing values
nadocast.availability_check: HTTP Last-Modified of each primary file must be at or before 09Z D; otherwise the date is dropped from the head-to-head and listed

common_grid: our sample centres; NadoCast value = nearest NadoCast grid point (great-circle), which must lie within 11 km (half the 15.237 km diagonal)
shared_footprint: box samples within 25 miles of US land (the v0.7 supported set) that have a NadoCast point within 11 km
labels: NCEI Storm Events Tornado reports (pinned 2024 file, labels-v04 manifest), within 25 miles of the sample centre, 12Z-12Z; identical for both forecasts

dates.excluded: 2021 and 2025 (sealed), 2022-23 (v0.7 training/calibration years), 2026 (Storm Events not yet final), 36 days of 2024 with no matched NadoCast file

passes_if: both primary NadoCast files fetched, hash-pinned and decode as TORPROB 24-47 in percent
every footprint sample has a NadoCast point within 11 km and the footprint keeps >= 95% of supported box samples
our v0.7 probabilities and labels load for both dates with the frozen feature order
the scorecard is produced with finite values

metrics.brier: mean over footprint points and dates; reference = sample base rate; difference ours - NadoCast with 95% date-bootstrap interval (5000 draws, seed 20261121)
at_each_threshold: hits = report points with p >= t
misses = report points with p < t
false-alarm area = km2 per day of footprint points with p >= t and no report within 25 miles (225 km2 per sample)
report days caught = report days with any report point at p >= t
metrics.reading: A difference is called only if its 95% date-bootstrap interval excludes zero; otherwise 'no clear difference'.

maps.active_day: fresh date with the most tornado report points in the footprint
maps.quiet_or_false_alarm_day: fresh date with no tornado report points in the footprint and the highest maximum of the mean of the two primary forecasts (symmetric, does not favour either model)

day2_wind_inventory: NadoCast 2022 models wind (and wind_adj), absolutely and SPC-calibrated, 12Z f24-47 exist for 330 valid days of 2024: same cycle and window as our Day 2 (12Z HRRR f24-48). A fair Day 2 wind comparison is supported; not scored in this run.
sealed: 2021 and 2025 are never requested from NadoCast or Storm Events; v0.7 and the collector schedule are unchanged

amendments.change: Reported-only NadoCast variants get the same availability check as the primary: SPC-calibrated and 2024_preliminary D-1 12Z f24-47 files must have Last-Modified at or before 09Z D; the later-cutoff Day 1 (12Z f02-23 on D) at or before 18Z D. A file that fails is treated as unavailable for that variant only.
amendments.evidence: Pilot run 44942469814: the 2024_preliminary file for 2024-04-14 was last modified 2024-07-24 (regenerated later, not real time); primary files were written 15:28Z on D-1.
amendments.unchanged: primary pairing, footprint, labels, dates, metrics, map rules
